entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: Aetherborn vampire from Avishkar, an investor, philanthropist and socialite of Ghirapur who aided the Renegades.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: Region of Kaladesh that Yahenni was from.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City of Wonders where Yahenni was a flamboyant figure.

entities.name: Prakhata Club
entities.description: Exclusive club of which Yahenni was an active member.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Revolutionaries against the Consulate whom Yahenni aided.

entities.name: Penultimate Party
entities.description: Yahenni's final gathering of friends and allies.

events.summary: Facing the end of their life, Yahenni absorbs the energy of Consulate enforcers and aligns with the Renegades.
events.quote: Yahenni chose to extend their life by absorbing the energy of a few of them

events.summary: After the revolution Yahenni holds the Penultimate Party and chooses to meet their end.
events.quote: Yahenni held what they called their “Penultimate Party,” a final gathering of friends, allies, and admirers

relations.quote: soon aligned themselves with the Renegades
Yahenni was an active member of the exclusive Prakhata Club

relations.note: Drained its enforcers and fought its control.
relations.quote: aiding their cause during the revolution against the Consulate’s oppressive control
